title: airy cardamom mediterranean eggs tagine
description: salty, crumbly post-workout dish featuring cardamom, papillote, jain-friendly.
instructions: heat the olive oil in the tagine pot over medium heat.
add the onion and garlic and cook until softened, about 3 minutes.
add the canned chickpeas, salted butter, green cardamom, and crushed red pepper flakes.
stir to combine and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
crack in the eggs and stir to distribute evenly.
pour in the almond milk and stir gently to combine.
cover the tagine pot with a lid and cook over low heat for 8-10 minutes or until the eggs are set.
stir in the chopped fresh parsley and lemon juice.
serve hot and garnish with additional parsley if desired.
place the tagine pot in the oven and bake for an additional 5-7 minutes or until the top is lightly browned.
carefully remove the tagine pot from the oven and let it cool slightly.
